narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Four parts, and four more, make eight tiny parts.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But each of the four quarters holds four tiny parts of its own.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>That is four groups of four, and not four plus four.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Splitting by ten keeps every place ten times the one on its right.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. Split a unit into three parts, and each part into three again. How many tiny parts are there?
